Hiring pack — weekend café chef

## Job post
You'll run our café kitchen on Saturdays and Sundays, 7am to 3pm, £14 an hour.
Must have: runs a busy kitchen on their own; food hygiene level 2.
Nice to have: bakes.

## Interview guide
Runs a busy kitchen: "Tell me about your busiest service. What went wrong, and what did you do?" / "Tell me about a time you ran the kitchen alone."
Food hygiene: "Tell me how you kept a kitchen safe on a busy day." / "Tell me about a hygiene problem you spotted and fixed."

## Rubric
Runs a busy kitchen — 1: no kitchen experience; 3: has worked a busy line with a lead; 5: has run a busy kitchen alone, with an example.
Food hygiene level 2 — 1: none; 3: in progress; 5: held, with a time they applied it.
